intro.summary: St Angela Merici, an Italian educator and founder of the Company of St Ursula, devoted her life to forming girls in Christian faith and learning.

blocks.text: You can pray the full St Angela Merici Novena below.
blocks.title: Introduction

blocks.notes: expanded canonical prayer references into full rosary texts; converted "mention request here" into a personal-intention pause marker; reused compacted prayer source from an earlier section; converted intention marker into sacred bell and personal-intention pause

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. May the holy Virgin Saint Angela Merici always commend us to your grace, O Lord, we pray, that, following the example of her charity and prudence, we may hold fast to Thy teaching, through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who lives and reigns with Thee in the unity of the Holy Spirit, one God, for ever and ever. Amen. St Angela Merici, you generously and joyfully answered God’s call in your life to form girls in the holy Catholic Faith and equip them with skills they would need in their lives. You graciously served the needy and those in poverty, and showed heroic love to all people put under your care. Pray for us, for the grace to serve God as faithfully as you did, and obtain for us the graces we ask in this novena, especially

Amen. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. St Angela Merici, pray for us! In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
